テキスト cha 350: Eiichiro Niimura's end as a divine messenger. His mind is buried in Shigatsu Youka, so he only utters words, whatever his intent. He has lost the lower body the dead do not need and only his upper body is exposed, so he cannot leave Shigatsu Youka's side.

His mission as a 'divine messenger' fulfilled, he has no intellect left and sinks to being an 'organ' that exists only to keep Shigatsu Youka alive. Whether he thinks it an honor or a humiliation, no one knows.

シナリオ名: To the Way Things Should Be
テキスト cha 350: He had become part of Shigatsu Youka as a divine messenger, but because the main body is fatally wounded, he too vanishes. Had all four divine messengers been gathered, Shigatsu Youka would reportedly have gained a resistance even to third-generation blood, become an immortal life form, and been able to live almost forever.
